TurretOldGamepass.png|Default skin on the Turret [[gamepass]]. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} 50Badge.png|Default skin on the Level 50 [[Badges|badge]]. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The first version of {{Color|Premium|XR300}} skin was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/178596165/profile LilDisquit]. *Although the Level 4 upgrade icon shows an explosive warhead, the '''Turret''' cannot deal explosive damage at any level. *The {{Color|Premium|XR500}} skin is a reference to the ''Reason 2 Die's'' [[w:c:r2d:XR500 Turret|XR500 Xbox mount]]. **It is operated by an [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]] guard. **It was also the only '''Turret''' skin to have a [[April Fools 2020|Funny Face]]. *The '''Turret''' was the oldest tower to have not received a single appearance change to any of its skins in the game since it was added, a period of over 6 years from the 5th of August 2019 to the 20th of August 2025. *The {{Color|Lunar|Crossbow}} skin may be inspired by the [[w:c:clashofclans:X-Bow|X-Bow]] from ''Clash of Clans''. *The operator of the {{Color|SpringFrenzy|Bunny}} skin has the non-binary flag on one of its sleeves starting from Level 2, which according to the operator's creator is due to the operator being non-binary.[[File:NonbinaryBunnyTurretProof.png|280px]]
